## kit XLVII (agent-c 2026-10-23, run 129): ugen temp order, IV-eliminated counter inits, gbi copies <a name="kit-xlvii-agent-c-run-129"></a>

Scratch harness: build only the NM object (`make build/non_matching/src/<seg>/<file>.c.o`, ~1.5 s for
game_libs_post) and score with `rdiff --raw --pins`; a side-by-side printer (`render()` of both objects,
row by row with `*` on mismatches) shows temp-number drift far better than the difflib hunks.

1. **Last run's lever-A float candidates were null.** bootup ~3844 and ~8167 are inside EXACT functions
   (6254 / CCE0, func_cce0 already has a float prototype); ~7915 is an integer index; timproc_b1 line 673
   is inside the exact 11D0, and the NM 1340 passes only `(s32)` casts. Agrees with kit XLVI: no float
   promotion rows left in agent-c units either.
2. **ugen temp numbering is evaluation order, and dead ops still take a register.** When the target's
   t-registers run 1-2 ahead of ours from some point on, the target evaluated an extra (later deleted)
   operation there. Fixes that landed:
   - 26D64 (93 -> 61): `CUR_A = (arg0 >> 8) & 0xFF` (u8 store drops the andi, t7 is still burned) and
     `lo = (u8) (arg0 & 0xFF)`; plain `(u8)(arg0 >> 8)`, `/ 256`, `(s32)` forms are flat.
   - 2C7A4 (206 -> 155): `o->hA = (o->hA - D) & 0xFFFF` (dead u16 mask, burns t1); `o->wE0 += 1` moved
     to the front of the accumulate (target evaluates it first: t3/t4 before hA/h8); h10 countdown read
     through the field (an `r` web sat in v1 for the whole loop). Biggest single win: case 0xC8
     `o->hE = o->hE + (s8)f()` -> `o->hE += (s8)f()` (-31): the spelled-out add evaluates the call
     operand first and swaps the addu operands; the compound form loads hE first.
   - 32E18 (17 -> 4): `p[0] = (p[2] = 0x8000, -1);` evaluates the 0x8000 constant first (target
     `ori t8` before `addiu t9,-1`) while keeping the store order 0 then 8.
3. **A float store of integer `0` gets its own `mtc1 zero`.** 32E18's 0xFC field: the target materialises
   a second zero into $f10 instead of reusing the shared $f0 zero. `= 0` (or `0.0`, `(f32)0`) instead of
   `0.0f` reproduces it (+1 word, length 158 -> 159 = target). `-0.0f` is a different constant (+2).
4. **The dead `or a0,zero,zero` at entry = an IV-eliminated loop counter init (24378, 315 -> 243).** The
   u64 clear is `for (srci = 0; srci < *(s32 *)(B + 4) / 8; srci++) t64[srci] = 0;` with the bound in
   the TEST: it is re-read (no trip count, no x4 unroll), uopt rewrites the loop to the pointer form and
   leaves the counter's init behind. With a named `n` bound it unrolls (+28 words); reusing `i` (live
   later) puts the init in s1. Also in 24378: `volatile s32 pad[16]` declared FIRST gives frame 0x80;
   declared LAST it does not grow the frame at all. Decl order then places the two spill homes.
5. **Display-list writes are the gbi copy-and-bump (1DCB4, length 284 -> 288 = target).** The target's
   `or v0,s5,zero` before each pair of stores is `Gfx *_g = gp++; _g->w0 = ...; _g->w1 = ...;`. Spell it
   as `p = gp; gp += 8; *(s32 *)(p + 0) = ...; *(s32 *)(p + 4) = ...;` reusing an existing pointer
   local: a NEW block-scoped local takes a stack home and grew the frame 192 -> 208 (buf moved).
6. **Dead `while (0) { g = g + 0; }` at the top of a loop body keeps a constant base in a register**
   (26790, 64 -> 41): &D now takes a3 in every switch case as in the target. Placed after the loop's
   first statement, at the case entry or before the `if`, it does nothing (or hurts). It did NOT help
   2119C (the proxy-extern hold there is still needed: plain `B = gl_d` folds every access, +32 words).
7. **Switch case ORDER is a layout lever:** 250C8's "cross-jump of cases 0 and 2" was just source order;
   writing the cases 0, 2, 1 matches the target's body order (82 -> 66), plus unsigned sub/rem (sltu).
8. **Named locals and frames (2B5F4, 197 -> 168).** Block-scoped locals in sibling blocks do NOT share
   homes in IDO 7.1 (every one adds a word). Hoisting the needed names to function scope and de-naming
   base / nv / v / v2 took the frame 96 -> 72 (target 64) and removed an ours-only `or` copy (length
   258 -> 257; `--nosp --noreg` now differs only by the target's two extra ptr copies, so the length gap
   is exactly those). One name is still too many.
9. **Unused NON-volatile arrays are not always free.** 32E18's `int pad[4]` between two Vec3 locals
   changes the homes (removing it: 4 -> 35) although `pad[4]`, `pad[5]` and `pad[6]` score the same,
   while in 24378 a trailing unused `s32 pad[k]` is dropped entirely. Test, do not assume.
10. **A function-scope named local's home IS its spill slot (bootup 8FA8, 15 -> 13).** `tbl` was a block
    local spilled to sp+0x1C across the realloc call; declared at function scope between
    `volatile int pad_t[1]` and `pad_hi[2]` the spill lands at sp+0x40 as in the target (lever B without an
    array). 2BB7C's frame 184 vs 136 has the same cause: 14 named locals take ~12 words above `args[10]`
    (args first moves args to the top and the names below, frame unchanged); the target fits its names in 8
    words below args -- needs fewer names, not done.
11. **Negatives.** Lever E (trailing `if (x) {}`) on 1DCB4 arg1 / arg0 and 26790 g / i: all worse. 26790:
    `g` as a parameter, single top assignment (+4 words, folds), q via typed index, per-loop counters,
    while(0) on i / q / p: flat. 250C8: rem never colours (homed at 48, "not colored, not splittable"
    in -zdbug:6); `sub[1]` array 61 -> 71. 25504: inlining idx loses the t-ring (76 -> 91). 2A258 (6
    raw, pure schedule of the two sh 2048 stores) and 240A0 (11): blockcut k=2 flat; any `while (0)`
    inside a switch case explodes the jumptable layout (11 -> 173). 2C7A4 C9 / CA: h / constant spellings
    flat. 32E18: decl order `o, b, p, q, zv, r, pad[4], v` + the comma Vec3 init puts zv at 68 as the
    target but v moves to 36 (target 32): also 4 raw, not committed.

## kit XLVIII (agent-g 2026-10-23, run 135): `if (v) {}` anywhere, the fold-and-test candidate trick, sweep results <a name="kit-xlviii-agent-g-run-135"></a>

Scratch: `g135/` in the session scratchpad. `psweep.py SRC FUNC UNIT MODE` = parallel (30 jobs) OUT-OF-TREE lever sweep
(cfe, or NCC for `*.cpp` donors; never edits SRC; scores `rdiff --raw --pins`, length-changing variants rank as
1000+raw). Modes: `ifpos` (`if (v) {}` after every statement x every scalar local / param; `BRACES=1` also after every
`{` / `}`), `wpos` (`while (0) { v = v + 0; }` at the same positions), `arr` (scalar `T v;` -> `T v[1];`, uses -> `v[0]`),
`w0` (dead `while (0) { a = b + b; }` at the first statement for every ordered pair of same-class locals), `ifend`,
`ifpos2` (every PAIR of `if (v) {}` insertions, `--lines` to bound it), `all` / `all2`. `greedy.sh` re-sweeps from the
best variant. `tryfz.sh unit FUNC VARIANT` writes one variant in-tree, refreshes report.json and prints objdiff fuzzy
before/after (then restores + touches the source). Standalone scores equal in-tree scores for every agent-g unit except
kernel_054_c (needs `-O1`) and the NCC / `-Olimit 1` donors (sweep the donor file with `--expected`).

   `stride * a2` was a ugen t-reg (t4) where the target has a uopt candidate in v1 (and the a3 reload one t-reg lower).
   Fix, all three parts needed:
   `{ char *b = *(char **)(self + 8); unsigned int q = stride * a2; b += q; if (q) {} f(b, a1, stride * a3); }`.
   Named `q` alone is copy-propagated back into the expression (still t4); `b += q` alone or `if (q) {}` alone stays at
   4. Folding the named product into the pointer AND giving it a second (empty) use makes it a real candidate.
   **Recipe: when a single-use expression temp should be a v0/v1 candidate, name it, consume it by a compound
   assignment, and test it once with an empty `if (q) {}`.** Landing needed the four USO import symbols pinned in

   message) on the unwrapped body.

     uninitialised local at entry is a legal C live-range lever. LEFT (10): fy (0x7C load) f14 vs target f2 and the

## kit XLIX (agent-c 2026-10-23, run 130): pin job, dead masks in unrolled loops, one-line statements <a name="kit-xlix-agent-c-run-130"></a>

No exact this run (objdiff already scored every jal / data field the pin job fixed). Scoring = `rdiff --raw --pins`.

1. **Pin job (baked USO jals).** Every `jal` row left in game_libs_post was a placeholder callee whose target word
   bakes a fixed address. Three classes, all legal symbol pins / renames:
   - named callees whose name IS the target (`gl_func_0003F010` = jal 0x3F010) and are neither defined nor linked
     (check `build/tenshoe.map` and every `src/`): pin the name in `undefined_syms_auto.txt` (34 names, plus the
     unique `gl_1dcb4_f1..5`, `func_3b110/3b164`);
   - a named callee that IS a defined splat-offset symbol (`gl_func_00036A48`, `gl_func_0003B1AC`): do not pin it,
     call a `gl_ref_<addr>` alias (same address, ROM unchanged even in exact functions);
   - generic placeholders (`gl_func_00000000`, `game_libs_func_0003443C`) used at many sites with different
     targets: rename per site. Mapping trick: temporarily rename the k-th occurrence in the NM body to a unique
     `__pb_k` (declared `extern int __pb_k();`), build the NM object once, read which jal index got which probe
     from the R_MIPS_26 relocs, pair with the target's jal list (counts were equal in every function), then write
     `gl_ref_<target>` (or keep the placeholder where the target word is 0x0C000000). 63 sites in one build.
   Script: scratch `probe.py UNIT FN:PLACEHOLDER ... [--apply]`. objdiff fuzzy did not change (it never counted
   these fields); `make all` + cmp stay clean. 21E58 / 276E4 now raw-exact too (already 100 fuzzy).
2. **Pin job (baked data offsets).** Same scan for HI16/LO16 rows whose symbol is an unpinned per-site alias and
   whose target word is raw: `D_2C7A4_2074` = 0x2074, `D_E354_1C310` = 0x1C310 (hi 2 / lo 0xC310),
   `gl_data_30AF4_45010`, `D_40304_k001` = 0x1AE0, `D_3B2EC_a/b` = 6, `D_00000000F` = 0x128 (= `D_33094_k`).
   The `.rodata` rows (jumptables, literals) are NM-object data placement and stay. Binding a literal to the
   target's reloc symbol through an extern (`*(f64 *)(alias + 0x14)` for E2D0's 0.1) is a memory load, not a
   constant: +8 words, reverted.
3. **Dead `& 0xFF` instead of `(s8)` in a uopt-unrolled loop (24378, 240 -> 9).** The x4-unrolled record copy
   `SB(dst, 2) = (s8)(SH(src, 0x1A) >> 8)` ran one t-register low in every copy. Spelled
   `SB(dst, 2) = (SH(src, 0x1A) >> 8) & 0xFF` (all four byte fields), the sb drops the andi but each mask still
   takes a ugen temp, and the whole unrolled body plus the remainder loop line up. Only the u16 field must stay
   unmasked (`& 0xFFFF` there: 240 -> 275). `--noreg` was already 0, so it was pure temp numbering.
4. **Dead u8 mask on an increment (26D64, 57 -> 49):** `CUR_D = (CUR_C + 1) & 0xFF;` (u8 store). `(u8)(..)`
   is flat, `(CUR_C & 0xFF) + 1` scores the same.
5. **A u8 local keeps a copy the target has (26790, 41 -> 28).** The target passes `v` (v0) with `or a0,v0`
   in the jal delay; `func_3b110(v, i)` with `int v` coalesces v into a0, with `unsigned char v` the copy stays
   and e moves to v1. Also: the F2 / F0 loop bounds read `&D` directly instead of a `g = &D` copy (no
   `addiu v1,a3,0`).
6. **Two statements on one line change the lui/addiu interleave (24378):** `q = seed; e = seed + 6;` on two
   lines gives lui q, lui e, addiu q, addiu e (or e-first variants), on ONE line the target's
   lui q / lui e / addiu e / addiu q (11 -> 9). Not a `#line` directive, just source layout.
7. **Any dead `while (0)` inside a loop body recolours the loop accumulator (25504, 76 -> 74):** sum a1 and
   the pointer bound a2 as in the target; position and contents do not matter.
8. **Negatives.** 32E18 zv/v homes: the 12-byte block above zv is fixed; comma init + pad[3]/[4] keeps 8 raw,
   every pad / volatile / block-scope layout either keeps zv 64 or grows the frame (alignment-quantised).
   240A0: per-case h locals, `return 0`, assignment-in-test: flat (h stays v1, target v0). 250C8: rem read before
   the compare, separate case-1 index, volatile / array sub: all worse (case-1 and lower `sub` must share one
   home at 36). 2BB7C frame 184 vs 136: each used named local costs a word, unused pads are dropped, `register`
   and decl order change nothing. 2B5F4 frame 72: removing sp2C / the block local d does not shrink it.
   2C7A4: case 0xC6's own `b` stub cannot be produced (dead statements are deleted; `break` / `if (1)` flat).
   1DCB4: target keeps arg1 in s8 and rematerialises &buf; volatile / u8 buf, hoisted q: flat or worse. E2D0
   sum / scale spellings, 8FA8 count spellings, 40304 while(0) permutations / FP statement order: flat.

## kit LI (agent-c 2026-10-23, run 131): copy elimination, the struct-copy lever, sweep-at-scale lessons <a name="kit-li-agent-c-run-131"></a>

Scratch: `c131/` in the session scratchpad (agent-g's `psweep.py` / `greedy.sh` / `sv.py` retargeted to agent-c, plus
`applyv.py TREE BASE MODE FUNC UNIT VARIANT` = port one sweep variant's line edits into the tree by content, and
`fz.py FN...` = objdiff fuzzy at origin vs the working report.json). Scoring `rdiff --raw --pins`; every kept step
confirmed by `scripts/refresh-report.sh` fuzzy.

1. **EXACT func_00008FA8 (bootup, 13 raw -> 73/73).** Append-with-realloc tail. The body was
   `count = tbl[3]; if (count >= tbl[2]) { f(&D_8714, self); count = tbl[3]; } tbl[3] = count + 1; ...`: count
   coloured v1, so the `&D_8714` lui could hoist above the compare. Target shape:
   `if (tbl[3] >= tbl[2]) { f(&D_8714, self); } count = tbl[3]; tbl[3] = count + 1;` -- the compare reads memory
   directly and count has ONE assignment after the if; count colours a0 (the arm's a0 use blocks the hoist).
   `if ((count = tbl[3]) >= tbl[2])` gives the same exact. **Recipe: a local copied before a test and re-assigned in
   the then-arm after a call = the decompiler's form; try testing the memory and assigning the local once after the
   if.**

   `*(Key3E9C8 *)p1 = *(Key3E9C8 *)p2;` (Key3E9C8 = `struct { int w; }`), the copy goes through one more ugen temp.
   Dead masks, `+ 0`, `| 0`, a block temp, `if (v) {}` anywhere: all flat. **Struct-copy lever: a same-size struct
   assignment consumes a ugen temp the scalar copy does not.**
3. **psweep mode `sc`** (c131 copy): rewrites each `A = B;` in the body to `*(SC4_ *)&(A) = *(SC4_ *)&(B);` with a
   file-scope `typedef struct { int w; } SC4_;` (add it once near the top of the TU when keeping a hit). It rediscovers
   3E9C8. **Hand-filter every hit: it is only the same program when A and B are both 4-byte objects** (int, pointer,
   f32). The sweep happily proposes s16 / u8 / 12-byte struct / array-row sources (6808 `v4C`, B75C `temp_v0_2`, 22760
   u8, 2A07C char store, 3B2EC `vt[i]` array decay) -- rejected. Kept: 201B8 `sub->ent[0].w0 = r[0]` 146 -> 69 (fuzzy
   96.03 -> 97.01), 55A0 `t4.w = ...` length 599 -> 598 = target (93.77 -> 93.93), 31C0 `obj2 = obj` (both
   address-taken) length 196 -> 202 = target (92.58 -> 93.12). Fuzzy-negative: 27E24 `d = o->def`, 36694, 3C43C,

## kit L (agent-g 2026-10-23, run 136): length-correcting sweeps scored by objdiff fuzzy, named products, comma ordering <a name="kit-l-agent-g-run-136"></a>

Scratch: `g136/` in the session scratchpad. `psweep.py` (run 135's, extended):
- **`SCORE=fz`** scores each variant by objdiff fuzzy (`objdiff-cli diff -1 expected.o -2 variant.o -o - FUNC`, the
  `right.symbols[].match_percent` of FUNC) instead of raw words. Standalone fuzzy tracks the report closely
  (6126C 82.7 vs 83.0, 1F14 84.59 vs 84.60). Use it on low-ratio functions where raw words are noise.
- Without `SCORE=fz`, a length mismatch now ranks as `1000 * |len delta| + raw` (not a flat 1000 + raw), so a
  variant that closes part of the length gap shows up.
- New kinds (`MODE=new`, or `allnew` = all + new):
  `prod` = name each `A * B` in a simple statement as `{ T q_ = A * B; ...q_...; if (q_) {} }` (int / unsigned / f32,
  with and without the test), `prodfold` = `X = Y + A*B` -> `X = Y; X += q_;`, `comma` / `oneline` = two adjacent
  simple statements as one comma expression or on one line, `swap`, `corder` = `X = (Y = K2, K1)` (both orders),
  `chain` = `X = Y = K` for equal right sides, `ccopy` = `x = (y, y)`.
- **Bugs fixed on the way, check old sweep results for them:** `swap` treated `break;` as a statement and moved a store
  after the `break` (dead code: 4118 "rose" 99.14 -> 99.21 by deleting a store; reverted). `swap` / `corder` now run only
  when both lines are plain assignments with no calls and neither side names the other's variables. With
  `SCORE=fz`, a compile failure used to score 99999, which is BETTER than every fuzzy score above 90%, so greedy applied
  uncompilable variants (`if (arg2) {}` on a union). Failures are now 10**9.
- `vfz.sh UNIT FUNC VARIANT...` prints standalone fuzzy + raw for named variants. `apply.sh UNIT FUNC VARIANT` writes one
  in-tree, refreshes the report, prints the 62F08 probe and every fuzzy change against origin/main. tryfz.sh's
  before/after read is unreliable (it printed 76.81 -> 76.81 for a change that really gave 90.43): read the report
  directly.

## kit LIII (agent-g 2026-10-23, run 137): the NCC test, three NCC exacts, NCC-only levers <a name="kit-liii-agent-g-run-137"></a>

Scratch: `g137/` in the session scratchpad. `nt.sh FILE.cpp [FUNC UNIT]` = NCC -O2 compile + `rdiff --raw` (+`RD=--pins`)
+ objdiff fuzzy; `ncctry.py UNIT FUNC` = lift a function's NM C body into a C++ TU (closure of the typedefs / #defines
it uses, extern "C" decls of every file-scope identifier it references, `()` prototypes -> `(...)`, undefined
identifiers auto-declared, conflicting externs dropped) and score it under NCC; `wire.py` = replace the NM wrap with an
empty placeholder + write the donor + Makefile lines; `pinscan.py UNIT...` = jal-target scan (NM vs expected, both
with undefined_syms pins). psweep gained `MODE=sc` (agent-c's struct copy, with a same-size filter that skips locals
declared s8/u8/s16/u16/char/short/double and SB/SH/LB/LH macro operands). psweep already handles `.cpp` (NCC).

1. **The NCC test: before hand work on a capped cfe NM body, compile it unchanged under NCC.** post0b / post1b hold
   C++; a cap that no cfe spelling moves is often just the wrong front end. `extern "C"` the function, `extern "C"
   { ... }` the externs, compile with `NCC -c -G 0 -non_shared -Wab,-r4300_mul -O2 -mips2 -32`. Run 137 batch over
   every owned 50-99% function (61 lifted, 39 needed hand C++ fixes and were skipped): NCC beat cfe on 5F5F0
   (+8.0 before any edits), b5 1F14 (+2.8, but one word short), gui 3714 (+2.4, same length), 5F984 (+2.9, same
   length), 533EC (+0.4, one word short); everything else dropped (titproc 5DC -12.8, b5 DF14 -23.9, arcproc 125C -5.7,
   64388 -6.6). Signals that it is C++: an FP operand / temp order that is canonical-but-wrong under cfe (5D134), a
   switch whose compares run in case order instead of cfe's `beqz` for case 0 first (51F5C = edg's case-order compare
   chain), a scheduling-only residual in a tiny loop (67D50).
2. **EXACT game_libs_func_0005D134 (96.5 / 23 raw, cfe cap).** Quaternion rotate about axis i by (c, s). Under NCC
   the plain body already had the target FP order (97.8). Then: `if (q) {}` after `if (j >= 4) j = 1;` keeps q in a0
   (no `or a1,a0` copy + `sw a0,0(sp)` home; the cfe `while (0) { q = &q[i]; }` lever does the same job) 98.0;
   `(f32)1 * s` written at BOTH uses instead of a `t` local (t coloured before s otherwise and swapped c/s into
   f14/f12) 98.9; then pointer colours by assignment order: `pk = &q[k];` assigned BEFORE the q[i] pair, `pj = &q[j];`
   after it -> &q[k] = a1, &q[i] = a2, &q[j] = t0 as the target. Declaring pk/pj in a different order changes nothing;
   the assignment position does. An inline `rot(f32 &x, f32 &y, c, s)` helper gives the right c/s colours but a
   separate `a` per call (f16 instead of reusing f0): not the source shape.
3. **EXACT gl_func_00051F5C (95.4 / 4 raw).** The run-105 cfe body recompiled UNCHANGED under NCC = 0 raw: the residual
   was cfe testing case 0 first. The in-unit callee gl_func_00034458 must go through a per-site blank alias
   `gl_func_00034458_51F5C = 0` (ROM words are `jal 0`); calling the real name links `jal 0x34458` and the ROM differs
   by 5 jal words (make all catches it, objdiff does not).
4. **EXACT game_libs_func_00067D50 (83.3 / 2 raw, 40 cfe spellings).** memset: plain `while (n--) *p++ = c;` under NCC.
   **Makefile order trap:** post1b has a later `REPLACE_FUNC_BODY := ...` line; a `private +=` placed BEFORE it is
   silently overwritten (the function then scores 18 = empty placeholder). Put new `+=` lines after the unit's `:=`.
5. **gl 5F5F0 85.0 -> 98.5 (NM-only NCC donor, 136 -> 11 raw, same 229 words).** NCC levers found on the way:
   - **literal CSE:** NCC folds `(f32)1` early, so `z = (f32)1` shares the `d2 < 1.0f` constant (one callee-saved
     register, one word short). `{ int one = 1; z = one; }` keeps it a separate rematerialised `lui at,0x3f80`
     (+1 word, 94.4 -> 98.1); `{ int zero = 0; x = zero; }` the same for the 0.0 (`mtc1 zero` instead of a copy);
   - **frame = declaration order, used locals only:** slots go top-down in declaration order, one word per USED
     local (unused declarations are free; block-scope ints count). Reordering to slen, len, xLook.., xRight.., v[3],
     x/y/z, d2 put every home at the target offset, and a separate `ulen` for the third normalisation supplied the
     missing word under the spill area (cfe's `dead[2]` slot lever is wrong under NCC: drop it);
   - copy-out order `z = v[2]; y = v[1]; x = v[0];` matches the reversed loads; the degenerate-axis arm ordered
     `yRight = 0; xRight = 1; zRight = 0;`.
   Residual 11: x colours f14 (target f0), the z*10 temp f12 (f18), and the `sw a1,160(sp)` mf home store sits in the
   jal delay instead of heading both arms. `if (mf) {}` before the matrix stores: 64 (len 225). A 1886-variant
   `SCORE=fz` sweep timed out under load (no result).
6. **NM-only NCC donors** (`build/non_matching/...: private REPLACE_FUNC_BODY += F=$(DONOR)` + prerequisite, ROM
   build keeps INCLUDE_ASM): 5F5F0, 5F984, gui 3714 -- only where NCC is the SAME length as cfe (or reaches the target
   length). NCC_CFLAGS has no `-I include`: a donor must define its own typedefs (and `NULL`) instead of
   `#include "common.h"`. Name donors `*_ncc_*` so purge-landing-objs.sh clears them.
   **Clip hazard:** a same-length NM-only donor in post0b can still move the NM clip. 533EC (NCC 97.1 vs cfe 96.1,
   both 93 words, donor .text 0x180 with 16-byte alignment) dropped game_libs_func_00062F08 to 95 (last word clipped):
   reverted rather than re-probing 0x2e850. 5F5F0 / 5F984 donors did not move it. Always check the 62F08 sentinel
   after adding any post0b donor.
7. **Pin job on agent-g units: nothing left.** `pinscan.py` over post0b >= 0x50000, every post1* / post2*, game_libs,
   game_libs_mid, tail, gui, timproc b3/b5, arcproc, titproc, mgrproc, eddproc, n64proc and game_uso: no NM jal whose
   pinned value differs from the target's (with pins applied to BOTH objects -- without that, every expected-side
   `gl_ref_` looks like `jal 0`). Rows on `.text` section-relative local calls are addend artefacts, not pins.
8. **Negatives.** 525F0 (3): NCC identical to cfe (v1 vs v0 reload); `return obj` and a lazy-getter class: worse.
   5165C (1): NCC 17 vs 16 words, the shared `lui at` tail pair is still the 66A50 cap. 6126C, 5F0B8, 533EC, b5 32C8,
   558A0 / 59E80 / 5165C / 66EEC / 690A8 under auto-NCC: lower than cfe. Post0b clip unchanged at `0x2e850` (no post0b

## kit LIV (agent-c 2026-10-23, run 133): the {cur, nxt} iterator under NCC, an inline first() for a separate result copy, field arguments read first, address-taken stack objects <a name="kit-liv-agent-c-run-133"></a>

Scratch: `c133/` in the session scratchpad. New: `ncc/` holds agent-g's `ncctry.py` / `nt.sh` repointed at agent-c;
`itscan.py` lists the NM functions whose TARGET has the stack-iterator advance (`beqz X; sw X,K(sp); lw Y,4(X)`);
`jtscan.py` / `allscan.py` list the NM functions with a register `jr` (a jumptable) and the raw diff of every NM
function in the agent-c units; `vscan.py` lists NM functions with cfront virtual calls (`lh` delta + `jalr`).

1. **EXACT game_libs_func_0003D54C (cfe NM 80.2 -> 100, NCC donor).** It returns the n-th child's value (0 when the
   list runs out) through the `{cur, nxt}` iterator of 3D48C. The target keeps next()'s `?:` result in a0 and copies it
   into the result variable (v1) in both loop-test delay slots. Two levers were needed:
   - **Enter the loop through an inline `first() { return next(); }`** (agent-c run 118 used this for 3DDC0). The
     extra inline level gives first() its own edg return temp, so the loop variable becomes a separate copy. With
     `next()` at entry, the temp and the variable coalesce (8 words). Every C spelling tried also coalesced them:
     result variable initialised, block-scoped or a separate copy; for / do / while; pointer or unsigned value type.
   - **`int r = 0;` initialised at its declaration** (`for (r = it.first(); r; r = it.next())`). Without the
     initialiser the copy is there, but r and the temp swap a0 / v1 (9 words).
2. **EXACT gl_func_00038C98 (cfe NM 60.9 -> 100, NCC donor).** A child-list debug dump with the same iterator
   (cur at sp+40, nxt at sp+44). The only change needed was **reading each print's int argument into a block-scope
   local first**: `{ int v = n->x0c; f(fmt, v); }`. With the field read written inside the argument list, NCC builds
   the format address first. The field load then lands in the jal delay slot, and o needs an extra `or a2,a0` copy
   (50 words against 49). The target loads the field first, then builds the format address. The old cfe body
   (60.9) had the walk unrolled by hand.
3. **gl_func_0003DF58 NM 82.2 -> 99.1 (NM-only NCC donor, 89 -> 90 words = target).** The old cfe note blamed an
   "uninitialised iterator seed". That word is really `lw t6,0x10(a0)` (o->head), part of the function since the
   3DF5C boundary moved to 3DF58. The function is two extremal searches over the same iterator. Pass 1 enters through
   first() (the node is copied out of the temp) and pass 2 through next() (coalesced), matching the target.
   LEFT (16 words): the two node webs swap v0 / a1. These had no effect: declaration order and scope, a separate
   pass-2 variable, `= 0` initialisers on either pass, reusing the a1 parameter, if/else instead of `?:` for ref,
   loop shapes, branch order, and psweep (ifpos with `--vars`, w0pos, w1pos, all3).
   A 192-cell grid (entry next / first / second() = first() of first(), loop next / first, function or block
   scope, `= 0` on either pass) found 12 raw: pass 1 written `Node *n = 0; for (n = it.next(); n; n = it.first())`,
   pass 2 plain next / next. Pass 2 is then word-exact. Pass 1 has its entry and loop temps swapped (a1 / a0,
   target a0 / a1), and the target hoists the loop's `move a1,zero` above the compare. But fuzzy drops to 97.3, so it
   was not kept. A default-then-if `adv()` (`Node *r = 0; if (cur = nxt) {...} return r;`) for the hoisted zero:
   33 or worse.
4. **Iterator scan (`itscan.py`) over every unit:** 34890, 38C98, 3D54C, 3DF58, 454C4, 49B3C (post0b) and 65494
   (post1b, agent-g). Results for the ones not covered above:
   - **34890** (cfe 90.35): an NCC port of the C body scores 90.2 (82 against 84 words). Class forms with
     assignment to `this` reached 81.5.
   - **49B3C** (cfe 96.86): an NCC class port scores 94.25 at the right length. It uses an array iterator returned
     by value (`AI Arr::iter()`, giving the 80 -> 92 -> 116 copy chain), real virtual calls, and the list iterator.
     **`(unsigned)this == 0` in the iterator's constructor keeps the target's dead `bnez` / alloc(12) fallback**;
     `this == 0` is folded away. LEFT: the frame is 112 against 128 (the target has a spare 12-byte slot between the
     return temp and `ai`, and the list iterator sits 4 higher). Dummy arrays at five positions only reached 70 raw.
     `AI *pai = &ai;`, with the loop going through pai, scores 95.94 / 71 raw (frame 120). Still below cfe.
   - **454C4** (2028 bytes): not attempted.
5. **NCC behaviour notes (from 4FBA4 / 34890 probes, no win):**
   - NCC accepts `this = (T *)alloc(n);` in a constructor (warning 3442, "anachronism"). It emits the alloc fallback.
     It does not emit the cfront base-conversion null guard, or a null test after the fallback alloc.
   - Class forms reach 77.4 on 4FBA4 (cfe 77.8). The vptr stores land in the target's order once the classes really
     have virtuals: the base vptr before its members (vptr at +0x5C after 0x5C bytes of data), the derived vptr after
     the base constructor.
   - The target's 4FBA4 stores the derived vptr even when the 0x90 alloc fails (`beqz v0` jumps to the store with a2
     = 0). The `new` temp lives in a2, spilled at 48 around every call, and is copied to s0 for the loop.
6. **Jumptable-donor scan (target 1):** no candidate whose only blocker is the table %lo. Register-`jr` NM functions

7. **NCC lift of the near-exacts (agent-g's `ncctry.py`): nothing beats cfe.**

   | function | NCC raw | NCC fuzzy | cfe fuzzy |
   |---|---|---|---|
   | 35B1C | 2 | 97.16 | 97.40 |

   **2ABC0** scores NCC 92.87 against cfe 86.44, but at 86 words against the target's 87. The 16-byte frame gap

8. **Negatives (do not repeat):**

8a. **EXACT gl_func_00035DAC (cfe NM 58.9 -> 100, NCC donor).** Two fixes:
   - **A decode fix:** the outer loop starts at `end = 0; init(&end)` (the NM ran the init once, before the loop;
     the target's back-edge `b` lands on the jal with `sw zero,72(sp)` in its delay slot).
   - **Every value is a one-word stack object whose address is taken.** NCC hoists the loop-invariant addresses
     into s0-s4, and `cur = sent` becomes a copy through two of those pointers (`lw t8,0(s3); sw t8,0(s2)`). cfe
     const-propagates the -1 instead.

   Frame = declaration order: `W sent, end, cnt, x, u1, u2, cur;` with `u1.v = 0; u2.v = 0;`. Those dead stores
   emit nothing, but each makes its local take its slot: the target's unused words at 56 / 60. Without them the
   layout is right but every offset sits 8-20 lower (17-19 raw).
8b. **gl_func_0003DD28 NM 67.3 -> 81.7 (NM-only NCC donor, 35 -> 36 words of 38).** The function is a factory:
   create(0), o->0x70 = 10.0f, a real virtual call through the vptr at +0x28 (slot 5) with &kind, then a list attach.
   The cfe body had the branch sense wrong: the target sets node->4 = 1 when node->0x14 is ALREADY nonzero. The
   vptr has to sit at +0x28, so declare it in a base class with 0x28 bytes of data and put the rest in a derived
   class: with one class, NCC places the vptr after all the data (+0x70). LEFT: the create() result is copied into
   v1 (o spilled at 40, kind at 44, node at 36, frame 56 against 40). The jalr delay slot is also a nop.
   Declaration orders combined with dummy locals: 15 raw at best.
8c. **game_libs_func_0004A9F0 NM 76.5 -> 89.25 (NM-only NCC donor, 39 -> 40 words = target, FRAMELESS).** This
   resolves the old cfe note's "callee-save-vs-leaf choice isn't C-steerable". Write the cell store as an **inline
   member `Self::put(i, src)`**. self then becomes `this`, which NCC copies into a3: there are no calls, so it is a
   leaf with no frame, matching the target. cfe promoted self to s0 with a frame. Also pass the source pointer as an
   expression (`a1 + idx1 * 4`, a loop-invariant t0), and make the grid root a named local inside put (v0). LEFT
   (21 raw): the inner cursor copy colours t1 (target v0), which shifts the -1 / &D registers by one, and the target
   loads src[0] before the grid. Leaving the grid root unnamed gives 17 raw but 86.95 fuzzy.
8d. **game_libs_func_0001D17C NM 89.0 -> 96.06 (NM-only NCC donor on game_libs_post, 31 -> 33 words = target).**
   cfe folds every display-list cursor step into store offsets (31 words). Under NCC, gbi.h-style per-packet copies
   (`{ Gfx *_g = p++; _g->w0 = ...; _g->w1 = ...; }`) for packets 2 and 3, with packet 1 stored through p
   directly, give the target's chained cursors (a2 = a0 + 8, t0 = a2 + 8, return t0 + 8). LEFT: colours only --
   record base v1 (target a3), the shared 0x0C1A0000 a3 (target t1), third cursor a0 (target t0). No change from a
   Rec* struct, an inline op() helper, a named constant, or the record read inline.
   **Makefile trap (as agent-g's kit LIII #4):** game_libs_post.c.o has a later `REPLACE_FUNC_BODY := ...29CCC`
   line, and a `private +=` placed above it is silently dropped. Put new post `+=` lines after that line.
8e. **gl_func_00044CE8 NM 87.5 -> 91.3 (cfe, same 43 words).** A decode fix: the pool at +0x378 holds 50 TWELVE-byte
   entries (the target computes n * 12 as `sll 2; subu; sll 2`; the NM had * 6), and its count is at pool + 0x258
   (= +0x5D0). `rec = pool + (*(int *)(pool + 0x258))++ * 12` gives frame 32 = target (40 before). LEFT (18 raw): the
   target holds the pool pointer in v0 (`addiu v0,a3,888`; count at 600(v0)), where cfe folds it into 1488(a3).
   An NCC inline `Pool::get() { return &e[n++]; }`: 26-28 raw.
8f. **gl_func_00036A48 NM 87.9 -> 97.2 (NM-only NCC donor, 82 -> 85 words = target).** The function returns the index of
   the best dot product over callback-transformed vectors. Under NCC, the callback returns `V3` BY VALUE (an edg
   return temp at 116, then a word copy into r through s4 = sp+92). `v = r` goes through a member `operator=`
   (float-wise lwc1 / swc1 to v at sp+164; a default struct copy is 89 words). v is declared first, plus an assigned
   5-word pad (`int pz[5]; pz[0] = 0;`), giving frame 176. LEFT (9 words): r at 120 / the temp at 100, against the
   target's 92 / 116. A function-scope r, `V3 r; r = ...` and pads of 0-8 words do not swap them.
   **Scan:** the target hoists two or more stack addresses into s-registers (`addiu sN,sp,K`) only in 35DAC and
   36A48 across the whole report: both were NCC.
9. **Post0b clip:** 0x2e850 -> 0x2e854 (3D54C placeholder host) -> 0x2e858 (3DF58 NM-only donor, 89 -> 90) ->
   0x2e850 (38C98 placeholder host, -8) -> 0x2e854 (3DD28 NM-only donor, 35 -> 36 words of 38) -> 0x2e858 (4A9F0 NM-only donor, 39 -> 40 =

## kit LV (agent-g 2026-10-23, run 138): FP literals and short calls under NCC <a name="kit-lv-agent-g-run-138"></a>

Scratch: `g138/` in the session scratchpad. New tools: `lit.py IN UNIT OUT [FUNC]` = replace every
`*(f32|f64 *)((char *)&<any D_ symbol> + OFF)` READ (not stores) with the source literal read from
`expected/UNIT.c.o` .rodata (shortest decimal that round-trips the bits; only units whose expected object carries
.rodata: timproc_b5, timproc_b3); `sym.py IN OUT` = one distinct `extern char X_at_OFF[]` per address-of site
(defeats NCC's base-address CSE); `fixdef.py IN UNIT FUNC OUT` = put back the `#define`s ncctry turned into
`extern int NAME(...)` (multi-line aware); `rv.py BASE OUT old new ...` + `P.sh` = quick literal-replacement
probes scored by `nt.sh`; `cfet.sh FILE.c FUNC UNIT` = the same probe under cfe; `gr.sh` = greedy psweep loop
with a `--vars` whitelist (keeps the sweep from inserting empty tests on uninitialised locals).

1. **EXACT timproc_uso_b5_func_00001F14 (551 words, cfe 84.7 / "a3 web" cap).** Two decode errors, both invisible
   under cfe:
   - **one fewer argument.** In each copy pair `dst = f(p38, 4, arg0, 2); p34[f(p34, 4, arg0)] ...` the INNER
     call passes three args. The target sets a3 = 2 once at the top (it is also the `== 2` compare constant)
     and never reloads it before the second call; the cfe body passed 2 explicitly, so the constant lost its
     a3 preference to t0 and every call grew an `or a3,t0,zero` (+2 words per pair, and under NCC +4 total).
     Making BOTH calls 3-arg (declared `(...)`) gave the exact length and moved fuzzy 87.9 -> 93.3. Rule: when a
     callee-clobbered arg register is used after a jal with no reload, try dropping that argument from the
     call, not register levers.
   - **FP constants are literals.** `*(f32 *)((char *)&D_00000000 + 0xC8)` (0.05f) and the f64 pair
     `1.333f + 1.3333 * t` were spelled as data loads. Under NCC the base address `&D_00000000` is CSEd into
     a register (`lui a1; addiu a1`, +2 words per region); distinct per-offset symbols fix the length but not
     the colours. Writing the LITERALS (values from `expected` .rodata: 0x3d4ccccd, (double)1.333f =
     0x3ff553f7c0000000, 1.3333) gave 99.85 / instruction-identical except the %lo offsets, and NCC's pool is
     emitted in the same order with no dedup (four separate 0.05f words, like the target). Then
     `((s32 *)(base + 0x3D0))[call]` for the copy and `(v1 == 0) || ...` without the v1 local closed the
     last register swaps.
   - **ROM wiring (the 5FC0 recipe):** the donor's local-section .rodata relocs are renamed
     `timproc_uso_b5_func_00001F14_rodata` by replace-function-body.py and pinned in undefined_syms_auto.txt to
     the RoData offset of the first literal (0xC8); the yay0 build bakes `lui at,0 / lwc1 200(at)`. The C
     placeholder must re-emit the .rodata LAYOUT the INCLUDE_ASM .s carried as .late_rodata (sizes and order
     only: f32, f32, f64, f64, f32, pad, six f64, f32 with distinct values, since IDO cfe merges equal literals
     within one function). In-unit jal targets (87A0, 1DB0) stay real names here: the USO .text is objcopied
     unlinked, so R_MIPS_26 words stay 0 as in the ROM. objdiff (raw CLI) shows 99.9 for such functions (reloc
     vs baked offset); the report config scores them 100 like 5FC0 / 1DB0.
2. **EXACT timproc_uso_b5_func_00008AFC (72 words, cfe 85.9).** The cfe body under NCC with `K = 0.9f` as a
   literal (pinned `_rodata` = 0x238) was 3 raw: two `addu` operand swaps on the cfront this-adjust. `e +
   delta`, `&e[delta]`, `(char *)((int)e + delta)` and a vtable-entry struct all keep the wrong order;
   `(char *)(delta + (int)e)` (int sum, delta first) gives the target's `addu a0,t0,a2`.
3. **Where literals do NOT help.** Under cfe the literal spelling is neutral-to-worse (32C8 99.49 -> 99.43,
   CEB4 94.2 -> 92.9 standalone): cfe never CSEs the `&D` base, so this is an NCC-only lever. Units without
   .rodata in their expected object (gui, titproc, arcproc, mgrproc, game_uso, game_libs) would need the values
   from the ROM data segment; not attempted. Address-of uses (`(char *)&D + 0x6E8` string tables) are data,
   not literals: sym.py per-site symbols moved nothing (BDEC, DF14, CEB4, 2B74, 32C8).
4. **NCC sweep of the rest of the owned units.** Fixed and recompiled the run-137 CCFAIL bodies (casts from
   int/char *, FW / TB5_F macros restored, ld4/ld8 struct externs): 76F0 77.9, 526D0 95.5, 5534C 96.9, 23FC 97.2,
   1C68 94.7, B154 72.1, B624 88.2, B368 81.1, D884 75.6, 4118 97.1, AC20 72.6, 65494 43.4, 3430 82.0, 15FC 89.4
   -- all below cfe. Newly scanned: b5 396C NCC 60.2 vs cfe 41.8 (same 46 words: NM donor), game_uso 7C1C 89.3
   vs 88.2 (1065 vs 1058 of 1071: NM donor), game_uso 3558 78.8 vs 66.2 but 231 words vs cfe 240 / target 252
   (moves away from the target length: not wired), game_uso 1DDC / B3C / 8CD8 lower, gl 2840 90.6 -> 90.8 with
   `if (arg2) {}` (same 111 words: NM donor). Every NM donor checked: only its own function's fuzzy moves in the
   unit; 62F08 sentinel stays 100.
5. **5F5F0 98.37 -> 98.69 (6 raw).** `x *= 10.0f; xLook = x;` colours x f0 and the z * 10 product f18 (target);
   `if (z) {}` after the copy-out and after the v[] refill. RESIDUAL: z itself in f14 (target f18) and the mf
   home store after the v[] stores instead of heading the else arm. A sweep winner put `if (y) {}` before y's
   assignment on the else arm: rejected (uninitialised local).
6. **Negatives.** kernel 8000235C natural struct/for form: cfe 81.7, NCC 87.7 (< 92.6). mgrproc 1824 under NCC
   lowers the inner switch as a compare chain (target has a jumptable): 86.2. game_uso 7C1C/3558 lit: no
   .rodata. b5 2B74 (99.36) is a cfront ctor building three V3 temporaries per child (pool -1500 / 1500 pairs at
   RoData 0x11C..0x130): a candidate for a real-constructor NCC rewrite, not attempted. Post0b clip unchanged at
   `0x2e850` (no post0b length change).
7. **EXACT timproc_uso_b3_func_00001C68 (cfe, 95.1 / 43 raw).** The documented "(c) addiu-vs-or zero-arg
   materialization" residual was a FLOAT `0.0f` third argument (`addiu a2,zero,0` = li of the float bits; an int 0
   is always `or aN,zero,zero`, docs entry feedback-ido-knr-float-call) -- routed through the existing
   `(int, int, float)` blank alias `gl_proto_1c94`. Then the `r > 0` counter bump: `fl = (int *)p44; fl[8] =
   fl[8] + 1;` re-reads the field off the 0x44 pointer (target `lw t3,32(v1)`) instead of CSEing the earlier
   load (`*(p + 0x20) += 1` forms) or materialising `addiu v0,v1,32` (`fl = p + 0x20; *fl += 1`). Two
   `if (arg0) {}` (after the `(arg0, 1)` call and after the flag-4 RMW) fixed the arg / delay schedule. Every
   `addiu aN,zero,0` in a target where the NM has `or aN,zero,zero` should be checked for this first (a scan
   of the owned NM functions found no other case).
8. **Parameter-only, fuzzy-scored lever-E sweeps (`PARAMS_ONLY=1 SCORE=fz psweep.py ... ifpos`).** Restricting the
   empty-test variable to PARAMETERS removes the uninitialised-local hazard and runs in seconds per function;
   winners still need a length check (591C's +0.35 moved 1096 -> 1097 away from 1093: rejected). Committed wins:
   game_uso B3C +1.9 (two rounds), mgrproc 2B7C +1.1 (two rounds), b5 AC20 +0.95, titproc 5DC +0.5, b5 C310 +0.6,
   game_uso 8CD8 +0.2, gui 3714 NCC donor +3.4 (four tests). No win: arcproc 125C, mgrproc 1824 / 23FC, gui 329C /
   4568, b5 32C8 / BDEC / CEB4 / D884, game_uso 1DDC. Raw-scored greedy sweeps on the 5F984 / 3714 NCC donors
   "fixed" the length while dropping fuzzy 88 -> 62 / 85 -> 76: always score donor sweeps by fuzzy.

## kit LVI (agent-c 2026-10-23, run 134): the full-unit NCC sweep, referenced pad arrays set the NCC frame, reuse a local to recolour, one pointer per packet <a name="kit-lvi-agent-c-run-134"></a>

Scratch: `c134/` in the session scratchpad. `ncc/ncctry.py` now lifts K&R definitions (the parameter declarations
are folded into a prototype) and keeps only the LAST typedef of a name before the function (units redefine
typedef names per NM block). `ncc/fixer.py IN OUT FUNC UNIT` patches the C -> C++ errors of a lifted body one per
compile round (up to 400): int / void * -> T * assignments and initialisers (3611 / 3232) get a `(T)(...)` cast
of the right-hand side, a mismatched return (3212) a cast to the function's return type, argument mismatches
(3252) a cast to the parameter type, incompatible comparison operands (3135) a cast of the right operand, an
undefined typedef (3114) the unit's last definition of it moved or inserted above the use, the auto-declared
`extern "C" char X[];` lines that collide with a real type are dropped (3194 / 3235), duplicate typedefs (3337)
are dropped, and `(*)()` function pointers become `(*)(...)`. `NULL` is redefined as 0. `ncc/drv.sh`,
`drv2.sh` and `padall.sh` run it across a list; `ncc/padscan.py SRC FUNC UNIT` scores `int padq[k]; padq[0] = 0;`
for k = 1..20 at the top or the bottom of the declarations. `ncc/mkdonor.py` swaps `#include "common.h"` for
the standalone typedef block a donor needs (NCC_CFLAGS has no `-I include`).

2. **EXACT gl_func_00042778 (cfe 77.0 -> NCC 98.5 -> 99.88 -> 100, 112 words).** Vec3 a2 + matrix column 2 of a1,
   normalised when longer than the 0.1 double at RoData +0x1B30, then two fixed-point coordinates
   32*4 + (v . column k) * 32 * 2. Three steps:
   - **operand order:** `x = a2[0] + a1[2]` (not `a1[2] + a2[0]`) gives the target load order;
   - **reuse len for the inverse:** `len = 1.0 / len; x *= len;` instead of a separate `inv` local. With inv,
     x / y / z / inv colour f14 / f16 / f18 / f2; reusing len gives the target's f2 / f14 / f16 and the
     inverse in f18 (28 -> 5 raw words);
   - **the frame:** the remaining 4 words were the a0 / a1 homes (56 / 60 against 104 / 108). x / y / z were
     already at 36 / 32 / 28, so the target has twelve more words of locals ABOVE them. **NCC gives a slot to
     every local that is referenced at all, even when its only store is dead**, so `f32 pad[12];` declared
     before x / y / z with `pad[0] = 0;` (or the struct copies inside `if (0) { t0 = t1; t2 = t3; }`) adds
     the twelve words with no code. Separately named constants (w2 / four2 / two2), named row and column
     copies, named int results, a named f64 limit and inline helpers all changed the code instead.
   The donor has no .rodata (the limit is read through `D_00000000 + 0x1B30`), so the plain placeholder recipe
   (wire.py) was enough; the sqrt call goes through the existing `gl_func_00000000_42778` blank.

## kit LVII (agent-g 2026-10-23, run 139): sibling macros under NCC, volatile homes, self-assignment then-arms, frames by declaration count <a name="kit-lvii-agent-g-run-139"></a>

Scratch: `g139/` in the session scratchpad. New: `dperm.py SRC FUNC UNIT a,b,c` (moves each listed
declaration to every other listed position, NCC-scored); `padscan.py SRC.c FUNC UNIT [decl]` (inserts a
declaration at every position of the top-level declaration block, cfe-scored); `emptyscan.py own.txt` (NM
functions whose target has more `cond-branch; delay; b join` empty-arm shapes than our build);
`framescan.py own.txt` (NM functions whose `addiu sp,sp,-N` differs from the target); `castfix.py X.cpp`
(inserts the casts NCC demands on `int -> T *` assignments, iterating on the compiler's error list).
`own.txt` = every owned 80-99.99% NM function with its raw rdiff line.

1. **gui_func_00003714 NCC donor 88.76 -> 93.54 (250 -> 256 words = target).** The run-138 donor was a
   register-mapped hand decode. 3714 is the third sibling of 2DE0 / 329C, which were already re-decoded as the
   stock gbi.h macros (gSPTexture, a texture-load call, gSPScisTextureRectangle with the `MAX((s16)..., 0)`
   clamps and the nested B4 ternaries). The same macro body (only the load call's arguments and x / w differ:
   w = arg4, `x = arg1 + (-(w / 2)) * arg5`) scores 81.3 / 260 words under cfe but 93.45 / 256 under NCC.
   `s32 pad[5]; pad[0] = 0;` (kit LVI: a referenced array takes its slots, the dead store emits nothing) sets
   frame 96. **Rule: when one sibling has a clean macro decode, port it to the others before any lever work,
   and try it under BOTH compilers.** 329C's macro body under NCC: 86.7 -> 88.6 (same 284 words, NM-only donor
   `gui_uso_ncc_329C_nm.cpp`, pad[2] for frame 88). 2DE0 under NCC is 86.5 but 297 words (cfe 298, target 303):
   first moved away from the target length; with `pad[6]; pad[0] = 0;` (frame 104) and two parameter empty
   tests it is 300 words / 88.75 (cfe 81.66, 298): wired as `gui_uso_ncc_2DE0_nm.cpp`. RESIDUAL in all three: the target keeps the ring context in a
   callee-saved / arg register (s0 or a1); ours keeps it in v0 / v1.
2. **gl_func_00002840 NCC donor 91.04 -> 93.05 (111 -> 110 words = target).** The target stores dy into its
   stack home before the sqrt call and reloads the home afterwards, and the final `sp38 = vy` writes the same
   slot. NCC (like cfe) instead spilled the register value to a separate spill slot. **Declaring that local
   `volatile` reproduces "store the home, reload the home"**: every source write is a store, every read a load,
   while the arithmetic stays on the register copy (dx / dy locals). Then sp3C / sp38 were moved after the f16 /
   f18 locals and len / dx / dy before p, which puts both homes at 60 / 56 (NCC frame = declaration order).
   Making sp3C volatile as well is structurally right but shifts the whole FP colouring (f16 / f18 locals ->
   f14 / f16): 83.1. Two parameter empty tests (psweep `PARAMS_ONLY=1 SCORE=fz`): 92.45 -> 92.82 standalone.
3. **timproc_uso_b5_func_0000CEB4 94.37 -> 97.13 (104 -> 107 words = target).** Block 1's then-arm is empty in
   the target but still emitted as `bc1f else; nop; b join` (with the join's first instruction in the delay
   slot). cfe folds every empty / dead then-arm into `bc1t skip`: `;`, `{}`, `do {} while (0);`, `f = ...`,
   `a0 = a0;`, `v[0] = 1.0f;` (v[] already 1.0), `v[0] = v[1];`, the if / else written with the cond inverted.
   **Only a self-assignment of an array element, `v[0] = v[0];` (or `v[3] = v[3];`), keeps the arm.** It
   leaves one `swc1 $f2,64(sp)` in the `b join` delay slot (target: the join's `lw a1`). Look for this
   shape (`emptyscan.py`) wherever the target has `bcond X; nop; b Y` with nothing between X's arm and Y.
4. **timproc_uso_b5_func_0000396C NCC donor 60.23 -> 86.26 (46 -> 47 words = target).** The target loads all
   three arg2 components before the first store to o: the stores go through a pointer that may alias arg2, so
   the source must compute all three results first. `x = tv + (x - tv) * h; t = arg2[1]; cz = arg2[2]; tv = t;
   yv = ...; z = ...;` then the three stores. RESIDUAL: colours only (tt f0 / target f18, o v1 / target v0);
   declaration order (dperm, 72 cells) changes nothing.
5. **gui_func_00000F04 82.17 -> 86.27 (cfe, 309 -> 315 of 313).**
   - **The cfe frame grows by one word per declared local and per `?:` temporary**, register-allocated or not
     (here: frame 0x130 against 0x108). Dropping 8 words of locals (cnt2-4 / cmd2-4 reusing cnt / cmd, one
     t / v pair for the nested blocks, three single-use locals inlined) gave 0x108, and 12 words of locals
     declared before spD4 put spD4 / spD3 at 212 / 211 (target). (In C310 / titproc 5DC, removing locals did
     not change the frame: there the slots come from arrays / spills.)
   - xa3 / xa0b typed int (the short type re-sign-extended them), and the three loop packets re-read the write
     base from a3->0xC (with one shared cnt / cmd this no longer double-loads).
   - The B4 word as the gbi.h gSPScisTextureRectangle expression (nested (s16) ternaries with MAX / MIN, dsdx
     re-evaluated in the B3 word too): 84.7 -> 86.2. Its ?: temps cost frame words (dropped a2v / a1v / a3v / v
     to compensate). The macro form of the two TEXRECT words LOWERS fuzzy (85.3 / 85.4).
   - The F04 body under NCC: 85.3 (317 words), below cfe.
5a. **PARAMS_ONLY fuzzy-scored psweep on functions never swept is still cheap money.** One to four rounds of
   `PARAMS_ONLY=1 SCORE=fz psweep.py ... ifpos` (parameters only, so no uninitialised-local tests): gui F04
   86.2 -> 91.2 (four tests, same length), b5 B368 81.3 -> 87.5 (three tests, 176 -> 175 of 173), b5 B624
   +0.2, gui 2DE0 NCC +2.2 and 297 -> 300 words, 329C NCC +0.1, arcproc 16F4 79.3 -> 83.2 (five tests,
   162 -> 166 of 170), titproc 116C +0.1. Rejected: game_uso 591C (+0.36 but 1096 -> 1097, away from 1093).
   No win: b5 DF14, gl 690A8 / 63964 / 76F0 / 15FC / 66EEC / 64388, kernel 18F0 / 1594 / 2250, game_uso
   97EC / BB8C NCC donors (97EC: `XZ d = a - b` / copy-init / friend operator spellings of the e temporaries
   do not swap the edg temp homes), No win also: b5 B154, gui 4568, 3714 NCC, 396C NCC.
   Run it after every structural fix: the F04 tests only paid off after the macro rewrite.
6. **objdiff fuzzy ignores sp offsets.** Frame / slot fixes (F04's 0x130 -> 0x108, titproc 5DC's block-local
   hoisting, padscan inserts) move fuzzy by < 0.05 even when tens of words change. Use raw rdiff to verify
   them; keep them only together with a fuzzy-raising change (they are still required for an exact).
7. **Negatives (do not repeat):**
   - b5 32C8 (5 raw, the 0x134 constant f0 vs f2): moving the zero vector, swapping vF8 / vEC, `vF8.z =

## kit LVIII (agent-g 2026-10-23, run 140): NCC + source literals for vec3 constructors, FP web reuse, tier-2 census <a name="kit-lviii-agent-g-run-140"></a>

Scratch: `g140/` in the session scratchpad (`lst.py OURS TARGET FUNC LO HI` = side-by-side raw+pins listing on top of
rdiff's renderer; `n2b_*.cpp` = the 2B74 donor steps; `gx_*` / `gz_*` / `gv_*` = 1DDC web-reuse sweeps).

1. **EXACT timproc_uso_b5_func_00002B74 (cfe 99.36 / 25 raw -> 100).** The cfront panel constructor's last residual
   was "g and the zero constant swap $f0/$f12 in both vec3 children" (run 117 onward; kit LV called for a real
   constructor rewrite). Steps, all on the UNCHANGED cfe body lifted with `ncctry.py`:
   - under NCC as is: identical 25 raw (so NCC alone is not it);
   - replace the six `*(f32 *)((char *)&D_timb5_2B74_v.. + 0x11C..0x130)` reads with the literals from expected
     .rodata (-1500.0f / 1500.0f): 18 raw, and the FP colours are now the target's (f2 / f12 / f0);
   - the remaining 12 words were the two stack homes swapped (vA / vB): NCC emits literals in SOURCE order and the
     first-loaded literal takes f2, so the -1500 line (vA) must be written before the 1500 line (vB): 6 raw, all
     of them `%lo` offsets of the donor's own .rodata;
   - wiring = the 1F14 recipe: `timproc_uso_b5_func_00002B74_rodata = 0x11C` in undefined_syms_auto.txt, the C
     placeholder re-emits the six-f32 `.late_rodata` layout with distinct values, NM types the 32C8 NM body
     still needs kept under `#ifdef NON_MATCHING` after the placeholder.
   - **gotcha:** `bake-data-relocs.py` reads ONE `NAME = VALUE;` per line. The donor references the per-site
     aliases `D_timb5_2B74_vt0..` that were pinned five to a line, and the yay0 bake failed with "no value for
     symbol". Split such lines before wiring a donor that uses them.
   A real-constructor version (`struct V3 { V3(f32) }` + an inline child ctor taking three V3 by value) also
   gave the target colours but added parameter copies (475 words): the cfront-lowered body with literals was
   the right shape. **Rule: when a cfe near-miss in a C++ unit is an FP colour swap between a literal-backed
   value and another FP value, rewrite the constants as literals and compile under NCC before any lever work.**
2. **b5 32C8 (the 2B74 sibling, 5 raw) does not follow.** Under NCC the body loses the target's zero
   rematerialisation on both alloc paths of the first vec child (24 raw), literals do not bring it back (31), an
   explicit `h = 0` on both paths is constant-propagated, and removing any of the three `if (1) {}` lines blows
   the function up to 390 words (a struct-copy mode switch). Under cfe, literal / shared-variable spellings of
   the first block are worse (7-13 raw).
3. **game_uso 1DDC raw 10 -> 7: same-name web reuse for FP webs.** The first scaling block's threshold
   (`*(a0 + 0x7C)`) coloured f14 (target f2). Storing it in `fz` instead of `fy` (both dead at that point; fz's
   other webs are products) gives f2; then the excess in `fy` instead of `excess` gives f0, and the three products
   f12 / f2 / f14... except the z product, which stays in `mag`'s web (f16). A 210-cell sweep of the three product
   names and 48 cells for the st_c1 block found nothing further; the st_c1 y product / zero constant swap
   (f14 / f12) is still open. Every name used must be dead at that point (check the later reads).

   threshold before the field (target order; the separate statement loads the field first). For the second alpha,

   the target, where `255.0f * field`, `field * 255.0f` and a named constant all give f16 / f10. RESIDUAL: the seq

## kit LXI (agent-g 2026-10-23, run 141): source-order switches under NCC, dead-epilogue phase in donors, store-tail sweeps <a name="kit-lxi-agent-g-run-141"></a>

Scratch: `g141/` in the session scratchpad (`audit/fpaudit.py` = per-function count of FP loads from `N(at)` in the
expected objects; `orc/mods.py` + `orc/match3.py` = parse every USO in the ROM once and list unreferenced function
starts per unit; `sw15/full.py` / `sw15/hill.py` = exhaustive / hill-climb statement-order sweeps under NCC).

1. **EXACT gl_func_00066EEC (message pump, 408 B).** The cfe NM body was a goto ladder on the message type
   (0 / 5 / 6 / 1 / 4 / 2) whose last test inverted to `bnel v1,at,top; b c2` (target `beq v1,at,c2; nop; b top`,
   "the documented last-beq inversion"). That tail is exactly edg's lowering of a `switch`: a compare chain in
   SOURCE order ending `beq last; <nop>; b default`. The same body as `switch (v) { case 0: break; case 5: ...;
   case 6: break; case 1: ...; case 4: break; case 2: ...; }` under NCC is word-exact except one nop before the
   unreachable epilogue. **Rule: a cfe goto ladder with a non-sorted case order in a C++ unit (game_libs, USOs) is
   a switch under NCC; try that before any ladder spelling.**
2. **The dead-epilogue nop is position-dependent (as1 aligns the dead epilogue block to 32 in the compiled .text,
   MATCHING_WORKFLOW #dead-epilogue-align-across-splice-56ec).** Measured by prefixing the donor with dummy
   functions: function at donor offset 0x10 -> 3 nops, 0x18 -> 1 nop (target), 0x20 -> 7 nops. The expected
   object has 66EEC at post1b offset 0x3F88 (8 mod 32), so the original TU had it 0x10 further (post1b is a later
   split); 66A50's 5-word pad gives the same +0x10 phase. Donor recipe: open the .cpp with an
   `extern "C" void <name>_phase(int *p)` of the right size (6 stores = 0x1C, two stores + return 0 = 0x18) --
   only the target function is spliced. Host placeholder = volatile stores sized to the exact slot (101 stores =
   0x198 here) so nothing after it shifts at compile time.
3. **EXACT gl_func_0005165C (64 B)** with kit LX's static-object recipe: `static int s[2]; { int &a = s[1];
   int &b = s[0]; a = 0; b = 0; }` gives the single `lui at; sw zero,4(at); sw zero,0(at)`; renamed .bss reloc

## kit LXII (agent-c 2026-10-23, run 137): shared-`lui at` audit, constant-CSE breakers, 4D468 re-decode <a name="kit-lxii-agent-c-run-137"></a>

Scratch: `c137/` in the session scratchpad. New helpers: `atscan2.py UNIT...` (run from the 1080 repo with the venv:

(`objdiff-cli report generate` into scratch: report-identical fuzzy in 0.1 s once the NM objects are built --
use it instead of `odd.py`, whose CLI defaults score some functions differently, e.g. bootup 1A44 91.70 vs the
report's 91.90).

   415A4 (one word written twice through one `lui at`), 45178 (its two RoData literals 0x1B64 / 0x1B68 -- as1

   same as cfe (23F98 74.33 vs 74.39; its residual is the s0 colour) or lower (2119C, 334E8, 2BB7C, 2E354).

   had the wrong node shape. What lined up:

     new-expression null test. The literal form also comes out of `reg(new (16u) E, s)` with a CLASS
     `operator new(unsigned, unsigned)` and an inline empty `E() {}` (same 124 words); a GLOBAL operator new plus
     an inline ctor gives the cfront `this ? this : operator new()` double call instead, and an out-of-line
     ctor makes the call conditional;

     `li a1,16`);

     in s2 across four calls for the later guard pair (one type change and it is rematerialised: 84 -> 95 %);
   - **the 0x3CB00 guard pair is ONE `static long long = 0x1234567812345678LL`.** Target: one `lui t6; ori t6`
     stored twice under one `lui at`. Two int stores (plain, references, `a = b = K`, `b = a`, an unrolled
     2-loop) always colour the constant into candidate v1; the 64-bit constant's two equal halves become one
     ugen temp and the static gives the shared `lui at`. (A zero long long store does NOT use `$zero`: `li t8,0;

     the loop call (`reg(p ? p : 0, s, 0)`) flips both sites to a3 at the cost of one `li a2` -- so in the

## kit LXIII (agent-g 2026-10-23, run 142): inline-member cursor reads, static long long pairs, audits <a name="kit-lxiii-agent-g-run-142"></a>

Scratch: `g142/` in the session scratchpad (`sw/swscan.py` = target compare chains on one register with >= 2
`beq`; `sw/gscan.py` = NM C bodies with `== K) goto` ladders; `sw/luiscan.py` = one `lui` serving >= 2 memory
offsets in the target (static-object signature); `sw/pairscan.py` = target `sw rX,o; sw rX,o+-4` pairs whose
register differs in the NM build; `sw/dis.sh UNIT FUNC` = expected-object disassembly of one function).

1. **EXACT gl_func_0005534C (156 B) and gl_func_000558A0 (124 B): the stream cursor read is an inline member.**
   Both walk a command stream through their own by-value parameter `s = {pp, w, ...}` (homed at sp+32, `&s`
   passed to every callee). The residual at 97 % was a v0/v1 swap: target cursor `p` in v1 and the post-call
   `s.pp` reload in v0, ours p in v0 and the reload in a ugen temp. No statement spelling moves it under cfe or
   NCC (`p = *s.pp; *s.pp = p + 1; w = *p`, `(*s.pp)++`, `*(*s.pp)++` as an expression, a named `pp` copy, a
   second cursor name, do/while / for / comma loops, a FREE inline `next(int **pp)`). Under NCC
   `struct St { int **pp; int w; int x; int y; int next() { return *(*pp)++; } };` with `w = s.next(); s.w = w;`
   is word-exact for both (5534C also calls the first word: `((int (*)(St *))w)(&s)`). Note the member body must
   be the post-increment expression: the member `{ int *p = *pp; *pp = p + 1; return *p; }` keeps the v0 form.
   **Rule: for a C++ unit with a v0/v1 swap on a cursor / accessor idiom, try the idiom as an inline member
   function under NCC.** Not a universal fix: gl_func_00068DD4's two reads (same idiom on `arg0` itself) stay at
   the same 19-20 words as cfe with the member (also `FW(arg0, 4) = s->next()` inline, a block temp).
2. **EXACT gl_func_00066A50 (148 B): the shared-`lui at` canary pair is ONE `static long long`.** Kit LXI left it
   at 37/37 words with the constant in v0 (target t8). `s = 0x1234567812345678LL;` on a file-local long long
   stores both halves from one ugen temp (`lui t8,0x1234; ori t8`) under one `lui at`; every int-pair spelling
   (references, chained, `b = a`, inline helper, pointer, unsigned) makes the constant a uopt candidate (v0) and
   cfe `extern long long` re-`lui`s per half. cfe and NCC give the same words; it went in as an NCC donor
   (`game_libs_ncc_66A50.cpp`, 0x1C phase function from kit LXI) with `gl_func_00066A50_bss = 0x0003F310` pinned
   in undefined_syms_auto.txt; host placeholder = 35 volatile stores (0x94). Agent-c found the same lever
   independently for 4D468 (kit LXII). The target-pair scan (`pairscan.py`) finds no other agent-g function
   with this signature (15FC's pair is the v0/v1 candidate below, 608A4's is an s-register colour).
3. **Source-order switch audit (target 1).** swscan / gscan over all agent-g units: unsorted compare chains are
   578B4 (already a goto ladder; NCC draft 95.0 < cfe 96.39) and gui 329C / 2DE0. DF14 / D884's chains are
   `x == 3 || x == 5` early-outs, game_uso 0B3C / mgrproc 2B7C are ascending (cfe sorts the same). gui 2DE0 as
   an NCC switch: 86.48 (cfe 88.75). gui 329C (open issue: target colours a callee-saved s0 for the PKT context,
   the switch value and the post-switch MAX temps): every web in s0 is call-free in the target, the
   instruction shapes after the switch are identical to ours modulo colours, and w / h / the switch value /
   the PKT context as a value live across the arm calls get stack homes, not s0 (a context NOT reloaded after
   the switch is spilled; 83.8). Probes: separate switch var, `switch (t = ...)`, decl moves, MAX into the
   switch var, register / int / char* -- no s0. Still open.
4. **Static-object audit (target 2).** luiscan over agent-g units: 66A50 (done) and the timproc_b5 vec trio in
   AC20 / B154 / B368 / B624 (`lui at; lwc1 0(at); lwc1 4(at); lui at; lwc1 8(at)`: x / y one static object,
   z a second one that AC20 also reads at +0x330). Those four are 83-88 % with 55-75 FP-colour diff words
   elsewhere, so no exact donor was attempted. **NM B624 88.57 -> 89.84:** its NCC lift with
   `static f32 sXY[2]; static f32 sZ;` and `{ f32 &x = sXY[0]; f32 &y = sXY[1]; ... }` for the head is 139
   words (= target, cfe 140) -- wired as an NM-only comparison donor (`timproc_uso_b5_ncc_B624_nm.cpp`). The
   target still hoists the shared `lui at` to slot 1. The same lift is worse for B154 (83.0 -> 72.5); plain
   cfe statics put `&sXY` in a register (lui + addiu, kit LX) -- +0.5 fuzzy but +2 raw, not kept. b5's RoData literal pool is in `assets/timproc_uso_inter34.bin` at
   file offset 0x71D0 (+0x11C = -1500.0f, +0x134 = -2500, +0x13C = 2500, +0x144 = -pi, +0x148 = pi, ...).
5. **gl_func_0005062C (99.9986, 1 word): the slot is the ORDER of the first statement's inline-expansion

## kit LXV (agent-g 2026-10-23, run 143): zero-literal spelling, named float args, 7C1C prototype, audits <a name="kit-lxv-agent-g-run-143"></a>

Scratch: `g143/` in the session scratchpad. New helpers (all compile COPIES under the scratchpad, never src/):
`cfa.sh FILE.c FUNC src/<seg>/<unit>` = the NM rule in scratch (asm-processor + cfe -DNON_MATCHING + post-process,
then rdiff + objdiff; NOTE the unit argument needs the `src/` prefix); `zsweep.py src/<unit>.c` = all-or-nothing
zero-literal variants per NM function; `zgreedy.py src/<unit>.c FUNC [START.c]` = per-site greedy `0.0f` ->
`0.0` (stores) / `(f32)0.0` (other uses); `zrev.py` = the reverse (`(float)0`, `(f32)0`, `= 0.0` -> `0.0f`);
`zscan.py` / `mfscan.py` / `lmscan.py` / `cvscan.py` = target-vs-NM counts of `mtc1 zero`, `mfc1 aN`, lwc1-fed
`mfc1 aN`, conversion ops per function; `opc.py FUNC...` = full mnemonic census; `fcscan.py` / `fpscan.py` / `sgnscan.py` / `ldscan.py` = float-constant
materialisations, FP arithmetic, signedness/width and load/store counts per function; `jgreedy.py src/<unit>.c FUNC` =
greedy join of adjacent simple statements onto one physical line (as1 per-line scheduling); `sw/curscan.py` = target
`lw X,o(Y); addiu Z,X,k; sw Z,o(Y)` cursor steps. Gotcha: `cmd | grep | head -3` on a cfe compile SIGPIPEs cc
before it writes the object (old `cfet.sh`) -- redirect to a log first.

1. **Zero-literal spelling is a uopt lever (cfe only).** A `0.0f` literal and a converted zero (a double literal
   assigned to a float, `p->y = 0.0;`, or `(f32)0.0` / `(float)0` / `(f32)0` in an expression) are DIFFERENT
   constants to uopt: the `0.0f` literal folds identities (`x * 0.0f` becomes a store of the zero, `x * 1.0f` and
   `0.0f + x` vanish) and CSEs with every other `0.0f`; a converted zero is never folded (`x * (f32)0.0` keeps its
   `mul.s`) and is CSE'd / held only with other converted zeros. Which spelling gives fresh per-store `mtc1 zero`s
   and which gives one held register depends on the site (8FC8: converted -> three fresh mtc1 at one site, one f0
   at the other two; 3558: converted everywhere -> one held f20 AND live muls; AC20: `(float)0` -> 0.0f hoisted the
   shared zero), so treat it empirically. An int `0` stored to a float was byte-identical to `0.0f` in 5F0B8, but
   kit LXIII found int 0 differing from `0.0f` in DF14 / D884 -- also site-dependent; sweep per site (`zgreedy.py`).
   Read the target's `mtc1 zero` count per site and pick the spelling per site:
   - b5 8FC8 (1624 words): target 12 `mtc1 zero` vs our 3 -- the three 0xB4/B8/BC zero triples are three separate
     mtc1 + swc1 in the target; `= 0.0` brings site 3 to the target's shape (84.73 -> 85.12, raw 1371 -> 1049,
     1595 -> 1600 words); sites 1 / 2 still CSE into one f0 zero (both `0.0` and `(f32)0` give the same);
   - game_uso 3558: the reverse case -- the target holds ONE zero in f20 for the side / w[1] stores AND keeps the
     three else-branch `w * 0` muls live (old residual class 2, "folds to f20 stores"). `side = 0.0`, `w[1] = 0.0`,
     `w * (f32)0.0` together: 66.15 -> 68.18, 240 -> 247 of 252; any one left as `0.0f` loses all of it;
   - b5 AC20: the late arm's `field > (float)0` test and `field = (float)0` store as `0.0f` share one hoisted zero
     like the target (90.68 -> 90.77, raw 286 -> 280);
   - greedy per site found small wins in 8CD8 (`p->y = 0.0;` 83.27 -> 83.57), 591C (`yaw < (f32)0.0` 94.08 ->
     94.13), 63964 (`va.y < (f32)0.0` 75.85 -> 76.03), 8FC8 (two call args + one store, 85.12 -> 85.35).
   Under NCC (edg) the spelling makes no difference (7C1C donor: identical words for all three spellings).
2. **A float call argument read through a named f32 local = `lwc1 + mfc1 aN`.** With a prototyped `f32` third
   parameter, `f(ap, &v, *(f32 *)(o + 0x114))` loads the word straight into a2 (`lw a2,276(s0)`); `ang =
   *(f32 *)(o + 0x114); f(ap, &v, ang);` loads it as a float and moves it (`lwc1 $f0; mfc1 a2,$f0`), cfe and NCC
   alike (volatile or member-read spellings stay `lw`). b5 AC20's three 071AE0 angle args: 86.29 -> 90.68 (329 ->
   332 of 333 words); `ang = ...` before `ap = o + 0xF4` +0.1. A `lwc1`-fed `mfc1 aN` census (`lmscan.py`) over
   agent-g units finds no other function.
3. **game_uso 7C1C 89.69 -> 92.25 (NM-only NCC donor):** (a) the real `void game_uso_func_00003FAC(float *, float
   *, float *, float, float)` prototype (kit LXIII #8 decision: decode fix): 89.69 -> 90.39, raw 1291 -> 1213,

## kit LXVII (agent-g 2026-10-23, run 144): a head before VRAM 0, kernel statics, NCC post-increment temps, cached counts <a name="kit-lxvii-agent-g-run-144"></a>

Scratch: `g144/` in the session scratchpad. `cmp.sh FILE.c|.cpp REF.dis` compiles (cfe or NCC by extension) and
diffs the first function against a reference listing with branch targets / jal masked (`posdiff 1` = only the
compiler's trailing alignment nop); `elf_drophead.py IN.o OUT.o N NAME` drops the first N bytes of a reloc-free
`.text` (metadata-only); `ksw.py` / `qsw.py` / `nqsw.py` / `s598*.py` = declaration x init-order sweeps.

1. **EXACT game_libs_func_FFFFFFE0 (492 B): the first game_libs function starts 0x20 bytes BEFORE game_libs VRAM 0.**
   `gl_func_00000000` (0x1CC, no C, 0%) read FP regs it never set. USO oracle: bootup.uso Text export 871 at
   section offset 0x1464C = ROM 0xDE50B8; the 8-word head (`lui/mtc1` 255 / 235 / 80, `mtc1 zero`, first `div.s`,
   all hoisted above the prologue) was exactly the old `bootup_uso_post` (0x1C) + `game_libs_pre` (0x4) bins.
   Decode (cfe -O2, one pass, ~10 min): colour fade toward (235, 80, 80) / 255; `base[4]` / `col[4]` are ARRAYS
   (memory: dead `base[3]` store kept, `base[1]` / `[2]` reloaded), scalar r / g / b get homes and are reloaded
   into `col`; frame 0x70 from decl order base, col, d255, r, g, b, t + unused `int pad[4]`; every sum written
   `product + field` (cfe emits `add.s field, product`); the 5-argument call needs a float-prototyped alias.
   **Landing a function that straddles VRAM 0** (the kit LX "move the yaml boundary" recipe does not work here:
   moving game_libs.c.o's start back would shift every intra-module symbol, and `.game_libs 0xFFFFFFE0` fails --
   ld computes the jal PC as 0x1_0000_00xx and every R_MIPS_26 "relocation truncated"):
   - new unit `src/game_libs/game_libs_head.c` (TRUNCATE_TEXT 0x1EC), linked as its OWN output section
     `.game_libs_head 0x00000000 : AT(...)` ahead of `.game_libs`, which now starts at `0x000001CC` (the old
     first function's size); overlapping VMAs are fine with `--no-check-sections`, and the head's VMA is nominal
     (no absolute intra-module refs; its jal / `lui` relocs resolve to 0);
   - game_libs.c: INCLUDE_ASM removed, TRUNCATE_TEXT 0x8944 -> 0x8778; expected/ game_libs.c.o = metadata-only
     drop of the first 0x1CC bytes + the gl_func_00000000(.NON_MATCHING) symbols (reloc-free object);
   - `gl_func_00000000 = 0x00000000;` in undefined_syms_auto.txt: the INCLUDE_ASM label used to DEFINE the
     universal blank-call placeholder at VRAM 0, so renaming the function needs the pin;
   - tenshoe.yaml: the two bins become a `game_libs_head` code segment; game_libs starts 0xDE52A4 / vram 0x1CC;
     `assets/game_libs_pre.bin` (tracked) removed; `splat --modes bin` accepts it and leaves tenshoe.ld alone;
   - objdiff.json: new unit; expected/ head .o = the build object (its pre-reloc `.text` == ROM bytes).
   Any other first-function-of-a-module with a pre-prologue FP head is the same shape (scan: last words of the
   preceding bin decode as `lui/mtc1` and the first function reads FP regs before writing them).
2. **EXACT func_80001184 (kernel): the shared `lui at` lever works on absolute kernel data too.** Target
   `lui at,%hi(D_80012D30); sw zero,D30(at); sw zero,D34(at)` -- one `lui at` for two stores = the SAME
   file-local static (kit LX). `static int sTab[11]` + the plain `do { sTab[i] = 0; } while (++i < 11)` loop is
   19/19 words (IDO peels 3 stores and unrolls x4; the loop bound `&sTab[11]` = 0x80012D5C). cfe and NCC agree;
   landed as a `.cpp` donor only so it stays out of `C_FILES` (a C donor must be added to the filter-out list).
   The splice renames the donor's `.bss` reloc to `func_80001184_bss`; pin it to the ABSOLUTE address
   (`func_80001184_bss = 0x80012D30;`). The REL HI16 / LO16 in-place addends survive the rename.
3. **EXACT func_80000598 (kernel byte copy): "redundant / dead `or` moves" = NCC post-increment temporaries.**
   Target: `or a3,a2` (dead count copy) before the test and per-iteration `or a0,v0; or a3,v1; or a1,a2`
   snapshots. The plain `while (n--) *d++ = *s++;` over unsigned-char locals copied from `void *` params under

   move" residual in a loop with post-increments: try the most natural `*d++ = *s++` form under NCC first.
4. **EXACT func_8000235C (kernel list clear): cached count re-read in the store arm.** The target reloads the

5. **EXACT func_80002250 (kernel, 268 B, sibling of 235C): the callee-saved register goes to whatever is live
   INTO the call block.** Old verdict: "arg0 vs counter contest for the single saved register". The target keeps
   o in s0 and the counter in a3 although nothing is used after the (terminal, `return -2`) callback. The m2c

## kit LXIX (agent-g 2026-10-23, run 145): kernel jump tables at +0x400, rmon = IDO 5.3 -O1 <a name="kit-lxix-agent-g-run-145"></a>

Scratch: `g145/` in the session scratchpad. `fd.py UNIT FUNC [ctx]` diffs expected vs build/non_matching for one
function (relocated `lui` / `%lo` operands and absolute branch targets masked); `tdis.sh UNIT FUNC OUT` writes a

1. **EXACT func_80001EC8 (kernel, 732 B, was 48.6): the "+0x400 runtime jump table" is pinnable.** Kit LXVII's
   decode (`g144/e7.c`) was one word short: the size-table add `D_80012D30[rec.type] += rec.size` keeps
   rec.type in a register across the store (a named-array store cannot alias the address-taken record);
   the target reloads it for the switch, which an INTEGER-CAST address gives:
   `*(int *)((unsigned int)D_80012D30 + rec.type * 4) += rec.size;` (`(&scalar)[i]` and `((int *)&x)[i]` do not).
   The BSS clear is an INDEX loop `((char *)buf)[i] = 0` (a `*p++` cursor schedules the size test into a
   beqzl). Landed as a cfe donor `src/kernel/kernel_000_1EC8.c` (filtered out of C_FILES); the splice renames
   its `.rodata` HI16 / LO16 to `func_80001EC8_rodata`, pinned to `0x8000A64C` (table at donor .rodata + 0).
   The ROM already carries the 12 entries at our 0xA24C (runtime addresses = our numbering + 0x400).
2. **EXACT func_8000858C (kernel, 552 B, was 0 with a "dangling tables onto audio data" HARD INFRA CAP note).**
   The note read the ROM at the absolute address; at -0x400 (our 0xA690 / 0xA6F0) sit a 24-entry opcode table
   and a 20-entry REGIMM table of runtime case addresses. The function is libultra rmon
   `__rmonGetBranchTarget(method, thread, addr)` (ultralib rmonbrk.c shape: SPECIAL jr / jalr via
   __rmonGetRegisterContents = func_80009B60, REGIMM / J / BEQ / BLEZ / COPz branch arithmetic, -1 default);
   the JALR test is `(inst & 0x7FF) == 9`. Only IDO **5.3** -O1 gives the `andi t0,s0,0x1f; or s0,t0`
   temp copies (7.1 -O1: `andi s0,s0`). Donor `kernel_022_ido53_858C.c`; its two table references (+0 and
   +0x60) share one renamed symbol, `func_8000858C_rodata = 0x8000AA90`.
3. **EXACT func_80009474 (kernel rmon RSP restore, 272 B, was 99.41, a documented "andi into pre-coloured a1"
   cap):** the same compiler: with the 0xFFF mask written inline in the call argument, IDO 5.3 -O1 emits the

## kit LXX (agent-g 2026-10-24, run 146): explicit base-reference casts move edg temps (5062C exact), audits <a name="kit-lxx-agent-g-run-146"></a>

Scratch: `g146/` in the session scratchpad. `uv.py UNIT_SRC FUNC VARIANTS.py` compiles SCRATCH copies of a whole unit
(asm-processor + cfe, NON_MATCHING, `-I` of the unit directory) for every `V = {name: [(old, new), ...]}` variant and
prints length / positional diffs against `expected/` (`SHOW=name` lists them); `spscan.py` lists every NM function with
raw / sp-masked / register-masked diff counts (pure frame-layout residuals show regmask 0); `n526/run.py` is the same
loop for an NCC `.cpp` base file.

1. **EXACT gl_func_0005062C (post0b, 2756 B, was NM 100.00 with ONE word left).** The NCC donor (kit runs 114-115) had
   every instruction right except the first `operator+` return slot (sp+348, target sp+356). The fix is the parameter
   types plus explicit casts at the call sites: `inline V3 operator+(const V3 &a, const P3 &b)` and
   `(s1 = v0 + (P3 &)v1) / 2.0f` in all six statements. With the cast, edg allocates the derived-to-base reference
   temporary AFTER the return slot, which supplies the 8 bytes the target has between the ctor temp (336) and the return
   slot (356). Probes that did not: member `operator+` (fixes the return slot but moves the ctor temp to 340), `(V3, V3)` /
   `(P3, V3)` / `(V3, P3)` parameters without casts, a named return local, `static` / `const` return / template / friend /
   forward-declared forms, casts on only the first statement (changes the frame), `operator/` as a member or with a
   `const float &` divisor. **Lever:** an NCC residual where a return slot or binding temp sits a few words off ->
   try base-class reference parameters with explicit `(Base &)` casts on the argument.
   Landing: the donor is now spliced into BOTH post0b objects (`private REPLACE_FUNC_BODY +=`), the C side is an empty
   placeholder, and the four recursive calls go through a zero-valued alias `gl_func_00000000_5062c_rec` -- the ROM's
   recursion is a blank USO import (`jal 0`); calling the function by name links a real `jal 0x...` (12 bytes differed).
2. **game_uso 97EC (NCC NM donor) 99.143 -> 99.152:** declaring `cr, t, *pm` BEFORE `m2` (whose address is taken) puts
   m2's home at the target's sp+32 (was sp+44). Still open: the e-statement binding temp (target 204) and the f-statement
   return slot (target 180) are swapped; casts on `(a - b)`, on `b`, `Vec3(...)` functional casts, by-value XZ ctor,
   free `operator*`, member orders and named temps do not swap them.
3. **gl 526D0 is an NCC copy constructor.** `struct Base { Blk6 m0; int m18, m1C, m20, m24; Base(void *); virtual void f(); };
   struct Obj : Base { ... Sub m84; ... Obj(void *, void *, Obj *src); }` with
